title: Emu-GMM: Measure-Theoretic Generalized Method of Moments Estimation
description:
emu-gmm is a JAX-native framework for Generalized Method of Moments estimation. The framework is named for the operator at its centre: emu reads as E_mu, the expectation under a measure mu. One operator interface — implemented against empirical, analytical, or synthetic measures — drives sample estimation, identification analysis, and simulation-based inference through a single computational pipeline.

The central architectural commitment is that variance construction is orthogonal to integration: E_mu[psi] is a property of the measure, while V_mu(theta) is a property of a separate CovarianceStrategy that can be swapped (iid vs cluster-robust vs replicate-weight) without changing what is being integrated.

The package provides Riemannian-manifold parameter geometry, a stratified and design-aware covariance ladder, identification diagnostics, iterated and continuously-updating weighting schemes, and a query algebra over the law of the estimator.
